answer: The atlas multiplier is published, charged in basalt, and thread lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 19 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 3497 identities would post 4354 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
